Name: Miss Coriel's Music Mod Reborn
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
This does have some music from the Older Custom Music Mods I've made.  But I also have added in new songs and got rid of some songs I didn't feel fit anymore.  For now, 1.0 is to get it out there.  You have:
[list]
[*]Seasonal Music, with some extra here and there.
[*]Title Music, two from the old mod, replaced one of them with something more fitting.
[*]Two themes for the loading screen
[*]Three themes for the new game screen (One is a remix of one of the other songs)
[*]Two Town Music Themes
[*]I actually got the secret woods to work properly (CM version always was buggy), even has a special winter song
[*]Mine music has been updated!  A few from the original but a bunch of new ones.
[*]Still has my custom Stillness themes and some basic event music.
[/list]
As I figure what to put in, I will update the mod!!  I will also get a playlist going soon so you can listen to everything... or you can download the mod and listen to it there.  
All themes are made by me!  No bootlegs or game rips!!

[u]Updates:[/u]
[list]
[*][size=4]1.0.1- [/size][size=3]Added new song.  Removed looping in most overworld songs in order for the other songs to play more.[/size]
[*][size=3]1.0.2 - Updated a song (thunder.wav) - not so loud anymore[/size]
[*][size=3]1.0.3 - Added the Sounds of Rain Pack.  [/size]
[*][size=3]1.0.5 - Added Nocturnal Ambience, Songs of the Sand, and Community Center to the pack[/size]
[*][size=3]1.0.6 - Converted all music to Vorbis ogg format (Makes mod much smaller).  Added a new song to Summer2 and Fall3![/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: DELETE Older Version First!! Converted all music to ogg, if you try to overwrite, you will have both wav and ogg versions on your PC.
